title: Inspections tab filters, summary line and needs-action counts
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Customers - View' and 'Work orders - View'.
  2. An asset whose inspections include: completed-after-release with a Monitor/Not OK finding not yet built; completed-before-release with issues; not-started; already built.
  3. Two users to sign in as: one who can build lines and one who cannot (set under Settings - Staff / Roles).
custom_steps:
1. Read the filter row (All, Needs action, With issues, Not started) and confirm each count is taken from the full list, not the filtered view.
2. Read the summary 'N of M need a work order'.
3. Confirm an inspection shows Needs action only when it was completed after this release, has a Monitor or Not OK finding, and has not been built from; a pre-release inspection is never flagged but stays reachable under With issues.
4. Open the same asset in two browsers, signed in as the build-capable user and the non-build user, and check both show identical counts, with only the action button differing.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A filter row offers All, Needs action, With issues and Not started, each count taken from the full list rather than the filtered view.
  • A summary reads "N of M need a work order".
  • An inspection needs action when it was completed after this release, has at least one Monitor or Not OK finding, and has not been built from; a pre-release inspection is never flagged but stays reachable under With issues.
  • Two users with different permissions viewing the same asset see identical counts; only the action button differs.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9103 (S5 — Inspection history on the asset record); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S5; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R10: “A filter row will offer All, Needs action, With issues and Not started, each with a count taken from the full list rather than from the filtered view”
  • S5-R11: “A summary will read "N of M need a work order"”
  • S5-R12: “An inspection needs action when it was completed after this release, has at least one Monitor or Not OK finding, and has not been built from. An inspection completed before the release is never flagged, because the data cannot tell one somebody already handled by hand from one nobody actioned. Those stay reachable through the With issues filter”
  • S5-R13: “Two users with different permissions viewing the same asset will see identical counts. Only the action button differs”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
